craft_notes: Sthāyin: lucid begetting. Rows: whence then begetter. Read aloud: sire.

lines: There the bright, whence mind and the five mind-senses —
there in mind to be born, endowed with all-subtle-birth might: it the begetter.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra sāttviko yasmāt manaś ca buddhīndriyapañcakaṃ ca tatra manasi janye sarvatanmātrajananasāmarthyayuktaḥ sa janakaḥ
